description: Return an indicative value range for a small private business from its yearly earnings and industry, using publicly reported average sale multiples. Earnings should be seller's discretionary earnings (profit before tax plus owner pay, interest and depreciation) for owner-operated businesses, or EBITDA for larger ones. Not a formal valuation.

industry.description: Industry or sector, for example "hvac", "dental", "restaurant", "manufacturing". Optional.

name: estimate_value_range
title: Indicative business value range
